content:
# ====================================================================
# tracker / app/app.R
# Russian Public Opinion Tracker — Shiny dashboard.
#
# Layout:
#   - Top section: 3 trackers side-by-side
#       1. Regime acceptance (Putin/govt/rightdir/trust latent)
#       2. Discontent / protest readiness latent
#       3. SVO (war) support latent
#   - Bottom section: supporting signals shared across all 3, with
#     toggleable selection.
# ====================================================================

library(shiny)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# FIX (audit 2026-05-05, Critical #7): define %||% BEFORE first use.
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

TRACKER_ROOT <- "."  # Shinylive build: data staged inside appdir

load_safe <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) as.data.table(readRDS(path)) else NULL
}

# Latent expanded indices
approval_latent   <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_approval_index.rds"))
discontent_latent <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_discontent_index.rds"))
discontent_sparse <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_discontent_sparse.rds"))
svo_latent        <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_svo_v2.rds"))
# Single-outcome models (cleaner, one survey question each)
approval_single   <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_phaseA.rds"))
discontent_single <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_protest.rds"))
svo_single        <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_ss_svo.rds"))
# Stan version of approval (alternative method)
approval_stan     <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "output", "tracker_stan_phaseA.rds"))

surveys   <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "data", "inputs", "surveys_weekly.rds"))
wordstat  <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "data", "inputs", "wordstat_weekly.rds"))
social    <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "data", "inputs", "social_weekly.rds"))
events    <- load_safe(file.path(TRACKER_ROOT, "data", "inputs", "events_weekly.rds"))


SHOCKS <- data.frame(
  name  = c("Bolotnaya", "Crimea", "Pension reform", "Navalny arrest",
            "Mobilization", "Wagner mutiny", "Navalny death"),
  date  = as.Date(c("2011-12-10", "2014-03-18", "2018-06-14", "2021-01-17",
                    "2022-09-21", "2023-06-23", "2024-02-16"))
)
WAR_START <- as.Date("2022-02-24")


# ---- Pre-compute z-scored signal panel ----

if (!is.null(wordstat)) {
  # Use share_mean (per-phrase mean share across regions, then mean across
  # phrases) instead of count_total_log. Robust to phrase-level staleness:
  # if only 3 of 43 war phrases have data this week, share_mean is still on
  # the same scale (it's an across-phrase mean, not a sum). count_total
  # would mechanically collapse with phrase coverage.
  ws_wide <- dcast(wordstat, week_start ~ phrase_group,
                   value.var = "share_mean")
  ws_long <- melt(ws_wide, id.vars = "week_start",
                  variable.name = "signal", value.name = "value")
  ws_long[, signal := paste0("ws_", signal)]
  # Mask weeks where the group had < 50% of its phrases active — not enough
  # data to trust the per-phrase mean either.
  cov <- wordstat[, .(week_start, phrase_group,
                      coverage = n_phrases_active / pmax(n_phrases_total, 1))]
  cov[, signal := paste0("ws_", phrase_group)]
  ws_long <- merge(ws_long, cov[, .(week_start, signal, coverage)],
                   by = c("week_start","signal"), all.x = TRUE)
  ws_long[coverage < 0.5, value := NA]
  ws_long[, value_z := (value - mean(value, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(value, na.rm=TRUE),
          by = signal]
  ws_long[, source := "wordstat"]
} else { ws_long <- NULL }

if (!is.null(social)) {
  s_clown_state <- social[channel_type %in% c("state_news","governor"),
                          .(value = mean(react_clown_per_post, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          by = week_start]
  s_clown_state[, signal := "soc_clown_regime"]
  s_clown_state[, source := "social"]
  s_sent_div <- dcast(social[source == "telegram"],
                      week_start ~ channel_type, value.var = "signed_mean")
  if ("independent" %in% names(s_sent_div) && "state_news" %in% names(s_sent_div)) {
    s_sent_div[, value := `independent` - `state_news`]
    s_sent_div <- s_sent_div[, .(week_start, value, signal = "soc_sent_divergence",
                                  source = "social")]
  } else {
    s_sent_div <- NULL
  }
  s_long <- rbind(s_clown_state[, .(week_start, signal, value, source)],
                  s_sent_div, fill = TRUE)
  s_long[, value_z := (value - mean(value, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(value, na.rm=TRUE),
         by = signal]
} else { s_long <- NULL }

if (!is.null(events)) {
  e_long <- events[, .(week_start, signal = "events_count",
                       value = log1p(n_events), source = "events")]
  e_long[, value_z := (value - mean(value, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(value, na.rm=TRUE)]
} else { e_long <- NULL }

signal_panel <- rbindlist(list(ws_long[, .(week_start, signal, value, value_z, source)],
                                s_long [, .(week_start, signal, value, value_z, source)],
                                e_long [, .(week_start, signal, value, value_z, source)]),
                          fill = TRUE)


# ---- Helper: build a tracker plot ----

# Compute the last week with any survey observation across all observed_* cols.
last_survey_week <- function(d) {
  obs_cols <- grep("^observed_", names(d), value = TRUE)
  if (length(obs_cols) == 0) return(NA)
  any_obs <- rowSums(!is.na(d[, ..obs_cols, drop = FALSE])) > 0
  if (!any(any_obs)) return(NA)
  max(d$week_start[any_obs])
}

# Number of survey observations in the last N weeks (any source)
recent_obs_count <- function(d, n_weeks = 12) {
  if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) return(0)
  obs_cols <- grep("^observed_", names(d), value = TRUE)
  if (length(obs_cols) == 0) return(0)
  cutoff <- max(d$week_start) - n_weeks * 7
  sub <- d[week_start >= cutoff]
  sum(!is.na(unlist(sub[, ..obs_cols])))
}

tracker_plot <- function(d, title, subtitle, color = "steelblue",
                          band_choice = "80",
                          show_observed = TRUE, show_shocks = TRUE,
                          show_surveys_only = TRUE,
                          date_range = NULL) {
  if (is.null(d)) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_minimal() + ggtitle(paste0(title, "\n(no data)")))
  }
  if (!is.null(date_range)) {
    d <- d[week_start >= date_range[1] & week_start <= date_range[2]]
  }
  # Compute "last survey observation" line — visualizes where forecast begins
  last_obs <- last_survey_week(d)
  ymin_col <- if (band_choice == "80") "lo80" else "lo95"
  ymax_col <- if (band_choice == "80") "hi80" else "hi95"

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(week_start)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[ymin_col]], ymax = .data[[ymax_col]]),
                fill = color, alpha = 0.20) +
    geom_line(aes(y = point), color = color, linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"))

  if (show_surveys_only && "point_surveys_only" %in% names(d)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(aes(y = point_surveys_only),
                color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "longdash")
  }

  if (show_observed) {
    obs_cols <- grep("^observed_", names(d), value = TRUE)
    if (length(obs_cols) > 0) {
      colors <- c(observed_levada = "black", observed_sputnik = "darkred",
                  observed_express = "purple3", observed_fom = "orange3",
                  observed_levadasim = "blue3",
                  observed_chronicles = "darkgreen",
                  observed_russianfield = "darkblue",
                  observed_vtsiom = "firebrick",
                  observed_sputnik_possible = "darkred",
                  observed_sputnik_join     = "tomato",
                  observed_express_possible = "black",
                  observed_fom_possible     = "orange3")
      for (oc in obs_cols) {
        p <- p +
          geom_point(aes(y = .data[[oc]]),
                     color = colors[oc] %||% "grey20",
                     size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7)
      }
    }
  }

  if (show_shocks) {
    # Filter shocks to within plot range so they don't extend the x-axis.
    shocks_in_range <- if (!is.null(date_range)) {
      SHOCKS[SHOCKS$date >= date_range[1] & SHOCKS$date <= date_range[2], ]
    } else SHOCKS
    war_in_range <- if (is.null(date_range) ||
                        (WAR_START >= date_range[1] && WAR_START <= date_range[2])) WAR_START else NA
    if (!is.na(war_in_range)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_vline(xintercept = war_in_range, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40")
    }
    if (nrow(shocks_in_range) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_vline(data = shocks_in_range, aes(xintercept = date),
                   linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3)
    }
  }

  # Pin x-axis to the requested date range. Data is already pre-filtered
  # at the top of this function; coord_cartesian here clips any vlines /
  # annotate elements that would otherwise auto-extend the axis.
  if (!is.null(date_range)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = as.Date(date_range))
  }

  # Mark "last survey observation" — beyond this, the latent is pure forecast
  # (driven only by signal observation channels, if any).
  if (!is.na(last_obs)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("rect", xmin = last_obs, xmax = max(d$week_start),
               ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.08) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = last_obs, linetype = "solid",
                 color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      annotate("text", x = last_obs, y = 0.04, hjust = -0.05,
               label = paste0("last survey: ", format(last_obs, "%b %Y")),
               color = "grey40", size = 3)
  }

  p
}


# ---- UI ----

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Russian Public Opinion Tracker"),

  tags$div(
    style = "background: #fff8dc; padding: 8px; margin: 8px 0; border-left: 4px solid #cc9900; font-size: 0.92em;",
    tags$b("Honest framing: "),
    "Three trackers side-by-side. Each is a latent state-space estimate fusing
    multiple survey sources (with estimated biases) plus selected non-survey
    signals where they materially help. Bands wide on purpose — see About tab."
  ),

  fluidRow(
    column(width = 9,
      plotOutput("plot_three", height = "850px"),
      verbatimTextOutput("freshness"),
      hr(),
      h4("Supporting signals (z-scored)"),
      plotOutput("plot_signals", height = "260px")
    ),
    column(width = 3,
      h4("Outcome variant"),
      radioButtons("variant", NULL,
                   choices = c("Latent expanded index"   = "latent",
                               "Single-outcome (focused)" = "single",
                               "Stan (approval only)"     = "stan"),
                   selected = "latent"),
      tags$div(style = "font-size: 0.85em; color: #666; margin-top: -8px;",
               "Latent: pools multiple measures. Single: cleaner one-question models. Stan: Bayesian posterior for approval (KFAS for the rest)."),

      h4("Display"),
      dateRangeInput("date_range", "Date range:",
                     start = "2019-01-01", end = "2026-04-30",
                     min   = "2019-01-01", max = "2026-04-30"),
      radioButtons("which_band", "Outcome interval:",
                   c("80%" = "80", "95%" = "95"), selected = "80",
                   inline = TRUE),
      checkboxInput("show_observed", "Show survey points", TRUE),
      checkboxInput("show_shocks",   "Mark shocks", TRUE),
      checkboxInput("show_surveys_only",
                    "Show 'surveys only' line (where applicable)", TRUE),
      checkboxInput("use_sparse_discontent",
                    "Discontent: include sparse pre-war components",
                    FALSE),

      h4("Signals to show"),
      checkboxGroupInput("signal_select",
                         NULL,
                         choices = if (!is.null(signal_panel))
                           sort(unique(signal_panel$signal)) else character(),
                         selected = c("ws_protest", "ws_war",
                                      "soc_clown_regime",
                                      "soc_sent_divergence")),
      sliderInput("signal_smooth", "Signal smoothing (weeks):",
                  min = 0, max = 12, value = 4, step = 1),

      hr(),
      tags$details(
        tags$summary(tags$b("About")),
        tags$ul(
          tags$li(tags$b("Regime acceptance"), " — latent factor from approve_putin,
                  approve_govt, rightdir, trust_putin across multiple surveys.
                  Each survey is one channel with own bias term."),
          tags$li(tags$b("Discontent index"), " — protest_possible + protest_join
                  across Sputnik, Express, FOM, plus wordstat regime/protest +
                  clown rate as additional channels."),
          tags$li(tags$b("SVO support"), " — chronicles, levada, russianfield,
                  vtsiom, fom war-era svo_support. Surprise: chronicles runs
                  ~4pp higher than levada war waves, not lower."),
          tags$li("Signals (bottom) are not approval estimates — separate scale
                  on purpose. They support 'something is happening' detection
                  more than level prediction.")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)


# ---- SERVER ----

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Pick the right outcome objects based on variant + sparse toggle
  picks <- reactive({
    v <- input$variant
    if (v == "stan") {
      list(approval = approval_stan,
           approval_sub = "Stan posterior — surveys-only Putin approval",
           discontent = if (input$use_sparse_discontent)
             discontent_sparse else discontent_latent,
           discontent_sub = if (input$use_sparse_discontent)
             "Latent + sparse pre-war components (mood, polsit_crit, ...)"
             else "Latent: protest_possible + protest_join + signals",
           svo = svo_latent,
           svo_sub = "Latent: 5 wartime surveys + signals (no Stan port for SVO yet)")
    } else if (v == "single") {
      list(approval = approval_single,
           approval_sub = "Single outcome: approve_putin (5 surveys, KFAS)",
           discontent = discontent_single,
           discontent_sub = "Single outcome: protest_possible (3 surveys + signals)",
           svo = svo_single,
           svo_sub = "Single outcome: svo_support (5 wartime surveys, surveys only)")
    } else {  # latent
      list(approval = approval_latent,
           approval_sub = "Latent: approve_putin / approve_govt / rightdir / trust_putin",
           discontent = if (input$use_sparse_discontent)
             discontent_sparse else discontent_latent,
           discontent_sub = if (input$use_sparse_discontent)
             "Latent + sparse pre-war components (mood, polsit_crit, ...)"
             else "Latent: protest_possible + protest_join + signals",
           svo = svo_latent,
           svo_sub = "Latent: 5 wartime surveys + signals")
    }
  })

  output$plot_three <- renderPlot({
    pk <- picks()
    p_app <- tracker_plot(
      pk$approval, "Regime acceptance", pk$approval_sub,
      color = "steelblue",
      band_choice = input$which_band,
      show_observed = input$show_observed,
      show_shocks = input$show_shocks,
      show_surveys_only = input$show_surveys_only,
      date_range = input$date_range)
    p_dis <- tracker_plot(
      pk$discontent, "Discontent / protest readiness", pk$discontent_sub,
      color = "darkorange3",
      band_choice = input$which_band,
      show_observed = input$show_observed,
      show_shocks = input$show_shocks,
      show_surveys_only = input$show_surveys_only,
      date_range = input$date_range)
    p_svo <- tracker_plot(
      pk$svo, "SVO (war) support", pk$svo_sub,
      color = "purple4",
      band_choice = input$which_band,
      show_observed = input$show_observed,
      show_shocks = input$show_shocks,
      show_surveys_only = input$show_surveys_only,
      date_range = input$date_range)
    p_app / p_dis / p_svo +
      plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1, 1))
  })

  output$plot_signals <- renderPlot({
    if (is.null(signal_panel)) {
      return(ggplot() + theme_minimal() + ggtitle("(no signal data)"))
    }
    d <- signal_panel[signal %in% input$signal_select &
                      week_start >= input$date_range[1] &
                      week_start <= input$date_range[2]]
    if (nrow(d) == 0) {
      return(ggplot() + theme_minimal() +
             ggtitle("(no signals selected)"))
    }
    if (input$signal_smooth > 0) {
      setorder(d, signal, week_start)
      d[, value_z_smooth :=
        zoo::rollmean(value_z, k = input$signal_smooth + 1,
                      fill = NA, align = "right"),
        by = signal]
    } else {
      d[, value_z_smooth := value_z]
    }
    p <- ggplot(d, aes(week_start, value_z_smooth, color = signal)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "z-score", color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            plot.title.position = "plot")
    if (input$show_shocks) {
      shocks_in_range <- SHOCKS[SHOCKS$date >= input$date_range[1] &
                                SHOCKS$date <= input$date_range[2], ]
      if (WAR_START >= input$date_range[1] && WAR_START <= input$date_range[2]) {
        p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = WAR_START,
                            linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40")
      }
      if (nrow(shocks_in_range) > 0) {
        p <- p + geom_vline(data = shocks_in_range, aes(xintercept = date),
                            linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50",
                            linewidth = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE)
      }
    }
    # Pin x-axis to date range (matches the trackers above).
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = as.Date(input$date_range))
    p
  })

  output$freshness <- renderText({
    pk <- picks()
    fmt <- function(d, label) {
      if (is.null(d)) return(sprintf("  %-22s: (no output)", label))
      lo <- last_survey_week(d)
      r4  <- recent_obs_count(d, 4)
      r12 <- recent_obs_count(d, 12)
      sprintf("  %-22s: last survey %s   |   survey obs in last 4w / 12w: %d / %d",
              label,
              if (is.na(lo)) "n/a" else format(lo, "%Y-%m-%d"),
              r4, r12)
    }
    paste(
      "Data freshness — where does direct survey signal end?",
      "(After the last-survey date, the latent is pure forecast or driven only by non-survey signals.",
      " Wide bands and the grey shaded zone mark this in the plots above.)",
      "",
      fmt(pk$approval,   "Regime acceptance"),
      fmt(pk$discontent, "Discontent"),
      fmt(pk$svo,        "SVO support"),
      sep = "\n"
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
